name: When should I repair or replace my sliding door lock?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair or replace my sliding door lock?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace a sliding door lock depends on the extent of the damage and the lock's age. If the issue is minor, such as a loose screw, a simple adjustment, or a clean-out of debris, repair is often the most cost-effective option. However, if internal components are severely broken, corroded, or if the lock mechanism is outdated and no longer offers adequate security, replacement is usually recommended. A replacement ensures optimal security and longevity, especially if the door itself is in good condition. We can assess the damage and recommend the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor issues like loose screws or debris. Replace if internal components are severely damaged, corroded, or if the lock is old and lacks security.
